test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To have sticky fingers

options.text: To remain joyful in a difficult situation
To have a tendency to steal

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To have a tendency to steal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To have sticky fingers"** refers to someone who has a habit of stealing. (चोरी करने की प्रवृत्ति होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The cashier was fired because he had sticky fingers and was caught taking money from the register.
 
 
 
• **Sticky fingers** metaphorically represent a person’s inability to resist taking things that do not belong to them. (अन्य लोगों की वस्तुएं चुराने की आदत होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The shopkeeper became suspicious of the boy with sticky fingers when items started disappearing.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To have a tendency to steal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be suspicious** (संदेहास्पद होना): To have doubts about something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** His sudden change in behavior made his friends suspicious.
 
 
 
• **To punish for a crime** (अपराध के लिए दंडित करना): To impose a penalty on someone for committing a crime.
 
 
• **Example:** The judge decided to punish the thief for his crime.
 
 
 
• **To remain joyful in a difficult situation** (कठिन परिस्थिति में प्रसन्न रहना): To stay happy even during tough times.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite losing his job, he managed to remain joyful in the difficult situation.
 
 

136:Tbfc,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
